description: Gives a reasoned indication of whether a South African taxpayer's crypto gains are likely capital (CGT, 40% inclusion) or revenue (fully taxed as income), using the factors SARS and the courts weigh: intention, holding period, trading frequency, how it is funded and whether it is run like a business. An indicator for discussion, not a ruling.

main_source_of_income.description: True if crypto dealing is the person's main source of income. Default false

run_as_business.description: Organised like a business: trading bots, a trading company, full-time activity, marketing

typical_holding_days.description: Typical days an asset is held before selling

uses_borrowed_money_or_leverage.description: True if purchases are funded with loans, margin or leveraged products. Default false

name: crypto_capital_or_revenue
title: Indicate whether crypto gains are capital or revenue
